CREATE TABLE suspicious_money_movements (
    risk_registry VARCHAR(255),
    alert_type VARCHAR(255),
    severity VARCHAR(255),
    details JSONB
);

INSERT INTO suspicious_money_movements (risk_registry, alert_type, severity, details)
SELECT
    ra.riskregistry,
    'Money Laundering' AS alert_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN (ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) > 300 THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN (ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) > 200 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Medium'
    END AS severity,
    jsonb_build_object(
        'tcr_score', ROUND(CAST((ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) AS numeric), 2),
        'wallet_age', ra.wallage,
        'turnover_rate', ra.wallturnrt,
        'linked_tx_count', ra.linkedtxcount
    ) AS details
FROM riskanalysis ra
WHERE ra.wallage < 30
  AND ra.wallturnrt > 5
  AND ra.linkedtxcount >= 3
  AND (ra.txchainlen * 10) + (ra.linkedtxcount * 5) + (ra.fraudprob * 100) > 150;
